identification: Late Victorian/Edwardian gold twin-bar brooch: two parallel bars between squared end posts with ribbed ball terminals, centre a six-petal flowerhead each petal set with a seed pearl around a small green stone (paste, glass or possibly peridot/tourmaline), flanked by two five-point star mounts each with one seed pearl, four small bead accents, gold safety chain and pin. Est. 45-50 mm long (no scale in photo). Typical Australian/English c.1890-1910 bar brooch. Lot page: estimate A$150-200, no current bid value showing (27 Nov ~19:55).
